limitations: 24 visible labels across correlated 10-second clips in two venues, not independent human ground truth. 96 unknown frames excluded, so conditional accuracy cannot establish whole-video precision/recall, shots or possession. Tiny blurred boxes are approximate. Maryland/Halifax footage previously used in separate player-detector evaluation.
center_match: Within max(4, min(12, mean reviewed box half-size)) original pixels of reviewed point. Each extra or mismatched detection on a visible-ball frame is false positive; unknown frames are excluded.
